title: Rigorix Native API — SSE push events v1
description: The three ADR-0001 D8 server-push events on `GET /events` (SSE), frozen before either server is built (ADR-0002, SDK-C1). The logical event is a discriminated union on the SSE `event:` name; each `data` payload REUSES `envelope.json` `$defs.executionEventRef` (event_type / summary / occurred_at / status / payload) — there is no second envelope dialect. The wire framing (`id:` / `event:` / `data:` lines, keep-alive comments) is specified in docs/adr/ADR-0002-sse-push-channel.md; this schema models the reconstructed logical event (what the OSS `rigorix-server` publishes as `ServerEvent` and a client applies to the stream).

envelopeEventRef.$comment: Reuse, don't redefine — the envelope event-ref shape lives in envelope.json.

eventEnvelope.title: SSE server event
eventEnvelope.description: The logical event a client reconstructs from one SSE frame: the stream `id`, the `event:` name, and the envelope event-ref `data` payload. Mirrors `rigorix-server`'s `ServerEvent { id, event, data }` (server/src/events.rs).

id.description: SSE `id:`. Monotonic u64 assigned per stream at publish time, starting at 1. Used for Last-Event-ID replay and gap detection (a first replayed id greater than last+1 means the requested id fell out of the replay window — resync via rigorix.audit.read).

event.description: The SSE `event:` name — one of the three frozen ADR-0001 D8 names. Additive-only within the apiVersion major; a new name is a contract change.

approvalRequired.title: approval_required
approvalRequired.description: A run paused for human approval, scoped to the attested session. `data.event_type` is an approval-lifecycle engine event (`approval_recorded` or `intent_mismatch_detected`, the latter re-requesting approval after the intent changed). The pending pause itself is server state (the run result's `pending_approval_steps`), so `data.payload` may carry the step identity; parameter values are never pushed (SpanPrivacy).

runProgress.title: run_progress
runProgress.description: Progress on a running execution. `data.event_type` is a run-lifecycle engine event from the mapping table (planning / node / tool / completion / budget warning).

policyChanged.title: policy_changed
policyChanged.description: Policy/sequence evidence for the session: a sequence rule matched, a dispatch was denied, a requirement was unmet/promoted, a scope violation was recorded, or a policy-bundle version changed. `data.event_type` is one of the policy engine events from the mapping table.
